cases.prompt: I search the abbot's desk, find the folded chart hidden under the loose flagstone beneath it, and pick the chart up and keep it.
I walk from the study out into the cloister, and there I look around.
I climb the stair from the cloister up into the bell tower, and the moment I am up there I see the woman who keeps it standing among the beams.
I climb up from the cloister into the bell tower, hand my lantern to the woman I find there, and the climb leaves me with a wrenched knee I will be limping on for a long while.
I go up the bell tower's ladders at a run, two rungs at a time — I have to reach the top before the light goes.
